judgments.supporting_quote: Ferrography is a technique that identifies the density and size ratio of particles in oil or grease caused by problems such as wear, fatigue, corrosion or combination.
The venting arrangement of the overflow tank is to permit the free passage of air from the individual tanks, the vent/overflow headers and the overflow tank vent to atmosphere under all conditions.
Bilge manifolds and valves in connection with bilge pumping are to be located in positions which are accessible at all times for maintenance under ordinary operating conditions.
Operation outside 70 to 120 % of BEP flow reduce the pump life (incl. shaft seal and pump bearings) significantly.
For carbon dioxide systems, hanging bars for a weighing device above each bottle row, or other means are to be provided.
If differential pressure is too high or too low, the pump may be damaged or have impeded efficiency.
Motor overloaded       - Pumping of viscous liquids - Larger motor or smaller impeller
Corrective Measures: Engineered or administrative procedures activated to reduce the likelihood of a failure mode and/or its end effect.
